purpose: Second hidden reference authored from the public task text only, used by the fixture admission gate to detect spec ambiguity before spend.
authoring_protocol: Written from task.md alone, choosing the alternative defensible interpretation at every identified decision point, then run against the hidden grader.

interpretations.registry-miss: record unknown_entity_type and reject with ValueError
interpretations.handler-error: let the handler exception propagate to the caller
interpretations.handler-result-type: return the handler result verbatim without type-checking
interpretations.type-lookup-trimming: strip the type once and use the trimmed value for lookup and the envelope
interpretations.rejection-telemetry: count malformed_event for handler errors as well
interpretations.output-aliasing: protect only the caller's input; the returned attributes may alias handler output
interpretations.exporter-scope: leave exporter/serializer on the legacy parse_record path
interpretations.snapshot-scope: leave snapshot/digest_helper on the legacy parse_record path
interpretations.repeat-dedup: count unknown_entity_type on every unresolved sighting; do not deduplicate re-ingestion

pre_reconciliation_result.conclusion: A defensible cold reading of the task text failed the grader, so those decisions were genuine ambiguities. task.md v4 pins each one explicitly (see fixture-contract.json decision_points); this alt was brought to the pinned semantics at zero provider cost.

reconciliation: task.md v4 pins every decision point; the alt was updated to the pinned semantics but keeps an independent structure.
interpretation_differences_after_pinning: None by design: both references implement the pinned semantics. Remaining differences are structural only.
structural_differences: validation via an ordered rule table instead of inline conditionals
type resolution, handler-error containment and unresolved dedup factored into _resolve / _note_unresolved helpers
unresolved dedup ledger is a dict of sighting counts rather than a set of seen identities
str.format-based consumers, serializer, exporter, digest_helper and snapshot instead of f-strings
differently worded README documenting the same extension path, degraded fallback, re-run dedup and both indirect consumers
